title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: National Oceanic Atmospheric Administration US federal agency responsible monitoring weather, oceans, atmosphere. National Centers Environmental Information (NCEI) world’s largest archive weather climate data, hosting observations 100,000 stations across 180 countries, records stretching back 1700s. NCEI maintains Data Service API, provides free, open access archive. Unlike many government data APIs, requires API key: can start pulling data immediately.

title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: NOAA’s archive covers wide range weather climate variables. Daily observations include maximum minimum temperature, precipitation, snowfall, snow depth, wind speed. Monthly annual summaries aggregate averages totals. data spans land-based weather stations, marine buoys, airport observation sites worldwide. Beyond current observations, NOAA publishes 30-year climate normals: statistical baselines calculated 1991-2020 period represent typical weather given location. widely used agriculture, energy, construction, climate research understand current conditions compare long-term averages. archive also includes hourly observations, precipitation data, local climatological records specialised use cases.

title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: flagship R package NOAA data, rnoaa (~3,300 downloads/month peak), archived CRAN February 2024 NOAA deprecated CDO v2 API. planned rOpenSci replacement never materialised. remaining CRAN package (noaa, 3 functions, ~180 downloads/month) still targets broken old API. readnoaa fills gap targeting NOAA’s current NCEI Data Service v1 API. provides dedicated functions common datasets (daily observations, monthly annual summaries, climate normals) plus generic fetcher full archive. Station discovery functions help find stations location name, check actually record.

title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: Normals carry climatological pseudo-date rather calendar date ("01" month, "01-31" day year), integer month, day, hour columns added alongside filtering joining. Four periods available: "monthly", "daily", "hourly", "annual". daily hourly periods accept start_date end_date narrow window. NCEI normals datasets published US customary units (Fahrenheit inches), unlike observational functions noaa_normals() metric option: asked metric units, API converts variables others (monthly average temperature stays Fahrenheit) turns temperature ranges negative, package always requests published units.
code: nrm <- noaa_normals("USW00094728", "monthly",                     datatypes = c("MLY-TAVG-NORMAL", "MLY-PRCP-NORMAL")) # Normals are published in US customary units: inches and Fahrenheit head(nrm[, c("station", "month", "mly_prcp_normal", "mly_tavg_normal")], 3) #>      station month mly_prcp_normal mly_tavg_normal #>  USW00094728     1            3.64            33.7 #>  USW00094728     2            3.19            35.9 #>  USW00094728     3            4.29            42.8

title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: Every NOAA data request needs station ID. three ways work . 1. Search location using noaa_nearby(): 2. Search name bounding box using noaa_stations(): Text matched literally, punctuation station name safe. Pass regex = TRUE want regular expression instead. 3. Check station records using noaa_coverage():

title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: NCEI applies automated quality control checks observations, flagging approximately 0.3% values. can include flags setting include_flags = TRUE: adds attribute columns alongside data column containing measurement quality flag codes. title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: Daily observations come Global Historical Climatology Network - Daily (GHCN-Daily), integrates data 100,000 stations across 180 countries. Monthly annual summaries derived Global Summary Month Year datasets. Climate normals follow WMO guidelines (WMO-. 1203, Guidelines Calculation Climate Normals) calculating 30-year averages. Station discovery uses GHCN-Daily station list, noaa_coverage() uses GHCN-Daily element inventory. inventory around 36 MB, downloaded coverage-aware function needs , cached thereafter.

title: Access NOAA Climate and Weather Data
text: NOAA data produced US federal government public domain. restrictions use, redistribution, modification. NCEI Data Service API free requires API key, enforce rate limits. package automatically throttles requests retries transient errors. Daily data requests spanning one year automatically split yearly chunks avoid API timeouts. Station coverage varies: stations gaps, record variables, stopped reporting years ago remaining station list. Use noaa_coverage() check relying station. package affiliated endorsed NOAA.

title: Climate normals (1991-2020) — noaa_normals
text: Four periods available, backed different NCEI dataset: "monthly" normals-monthly-1991-2020. Twelve rows per station. "daily" normals-daily-1991-2020. One row per day year. "hourly" normals-hourly-1991-2020. One row per hour year. "annual" normals-annualseasonal-1991-2020. One row per station, covering annual seasonal statistics. daily hourly datasets require date window, supplied automatically full calendar year unless narrow start_date end_date. normals climatological rather tied particular year, month day arguments meaningful. Normals carry climatological pseudo-date rather calendar date: "01" month, "01-31" day year. returned verbatim date, integer month, day, hour columns added alongside filtering joining. annual seasonal dataset date column .

title: Climate normals (1991-2020) — noaa_normals
text: NCEI normals datasets published United States customary units (degrees Fahrenheit, inches). Asked metric units, API converts inconsistently: precipitation monthly maximum minimum temperature converted, monthly average temperature , temperature ranges converted temperatures (giving negative diurnal ranges). function therefore always requests published units , unlike observational functions, metric option. Convert fact need Celsius millimetres.

what: readnoaa: Access 'NOAA' Climate and Weather Data — readnoaa-package
title: readnoaa: Access 'NOAA' Climate and Weather Data — readnoaa-package
text: Provides clean, tidy access climate weather data 'National Oceanic Atmospheric Administration' ('NOAA') via 'National Centers Environmental Information' ('NCEI') Data Service API https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/support/access-data-service-api-user-documentation. Covers daily weather observations, monthly annual summaries, 30-year climate normals 100,000 stations across 180 countries. API key required. Dedicated functions handle common datasets, generic fetcher provides access 'NCEI' datasets. Station discovery functions help users find stations location name. Data downloaded first use cached locally subsequent calls. package endorsed certified 'NOAA'.

title: readnoaa: Access 'NOAA' Climate and Weather Data — readnoaa-package

what: Normals mixed units, and some values were wrong
title: readnoaa 0.2.2
text: NCEI normals published US customary units, help page said noaa_normals() returned inches degrees Fahrenheit. request asked metric units, normals endpoint applies inconsistently: converts precipitation, snowfall, monthly maximum minimum temperature, monthly average temperature, converts temperature ranges temperatures. Central Park January returned precipitation 92.5 (millimetres) beside average temperature 33.7 (Fahrenheit), maximum 4.2 (Celsius), diurnal temperature range -11.4, published value 11.5 F (6.4 C). Nothing output said units differed. noaa_normals(), noaa_get() normals- dataset, now request standard units, every column units help page documents: 3.64 inches, 33.7 F, 39.5 F 11.5 F. Precipitation, snowfall temperature normals therefore change 0.2.1. observational datasets convert consistently still default metric.
